_note: S95F final SDR profile, 24/25/30 Hz output (YCbCr 4:4:4). Calibrated WITH a global dim B=60 that was cancelled by a TV-side whole-picture gain of 1/(1-60/255) x 1.027 (needs TV device access and the separate documented TV gain controller). Without such a gain, B=60 makes the whole picture ~23% darker in code values - use starter-sdr.json (B=0) and calibrate your own panel instead. strips: column -> [alpha, R, G, B] lift premultiplied, 0..255. Result (camera, core columns): 0.96-1.19 at grey 13, ~1.0-1.1 at 26, 0.98-1.09 at 51, 0.96-1.05 at 102; luma 0.92-1.05 after the chroma-aware step. Uncorrected: 0.05-0.45 depending on level and colour.
